Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for a commercially driven and digitally fluent Marketing & Media Senior Manager to lead digital & paid media delivery across multiple markets out of our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.
The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with operational excellence, has strong all round marketing knowledge (marketing, trade marketing, PR) with deep expertise in paid media and digital performance marketing, and understands the nuances of luxury consumer behaviour across diverse global audiences.

Your Impact

1.    Local Media / Marketing Leadership
•    Depending on the size and staffing of the markets in your scope, act as either the local digital media lead, local media lead or local marketing lead.
•    Ensure media campaigns drive brand strategy and align with global standards, while  reflecting local audience behaviour, seasonal demand patterns, language requirements, and cultural nuances.
•    Partner with local sales and marketing teams to support market-specific business and commercial objectives, and with global marketing and media teams to ensure strategic and executional brand consistency.

2.    Digital Campaign Delivery
•    Lead the end-to-end delivery of digital marketing campaigns across multiple markets, ensuring timely execution, consistency, with all placements and asset adaptations meeting luxury brand standards
•    Coordinate with creative, content, CRM, ecommerce, and digital teams to ensure seamless campaign integration and customer journey alignment.

3.    Paid Media Strategy & Performance
•    Develop & execute local paid media strategies across multiple markets.
•    Manage local agency, platforms and media partner relationships.

4.    Measurement & performance analysis

Own the integrated measurement of media across the marketing funnel. Monitor and analyse performance and optimize investments to drive brand awareness, revenue growth, customer acquisition, and direct bookings, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement, including reports and presentations for senior leadership.

5.    Media thought leadership & innovation

Own the innovation plan across channels. Identify the latest media industry developments, recommending test & learn plans to integrate the relevant areas to Explora journey’s media strategy.

6.    Build media literacy

Step-change media knowledge in markets across departments to enhance media planning capabilities and excellence in delivery.

7.    Budget management

Own the global media budget planning, spending and stewardship, including agency/vendor management

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree

- 15+ years of client side roles in global and local media including planning, ATL/BTL and directly running digital media

- Strong marketing knowledge (marketing, trade marketing, PR)

- Outstanding luxury media understanding: in-depth knowledge of offline and digital media, the interdependencies between paid, owned and earned media, as well as luxury media specifics

- Proven ability to roll-up your sleeves and execute with excellence

- Track record of managing agencies, platforms and media partners and building effective partnerships

Your Essentials

- Strategic and innovative critical thinker.

- Structured, well organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects, thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment.

- Outstanding collaboration and influencing skills, with proven ability to navigate a matrix organisation. Effectively organize teams to deliver business outcomes.

- Proven analytical skills with proficiency in media tools and platforms

- Strong preference for prior experience in the luxury or luxury hospitality/travel industry. A personal passion for luxury travel and global mindset.

- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Fluent in English.

- Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever-evolving media industry.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for a talented, skilled at analysis, strategic and highly organized professional with strong marketing, digital and commercial acumen to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys, based in our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.

Your Impact

- The objective of the role is to optimize full-funnel marketing investments holistically, maximizing revenue impact and ROI optimization across markets. This role is responsible for analysing performance across the customer journey — from awareness through loyalty — to identify growth opportunities, improve marketing efficiency, and drive commercial outcomes through data-driven decision-making.
Performance analysis: monitor and analyse marketing performance against brand and commercial KPIs, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement. Own the development, tracking and actioning of key marketing KPIs across touchpoint (all paid, owned and earned channels), campaigns and audience performance.

- Drive efficiency, quantifying ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA by campaign, touchpoint and audience for each market to continuously optimize investments. Recommend reinvestments toward highest-impact activities, to hit awareness and revenue targets.

- Build and maintain full-funnel performance scorecards by market (awareness → consideration → conversion → loyalty) to identify revenue bottlenecks and optimize budget allocation between markets. Both on Excel and partnering with corporate team to make it available in self-serve tools (Power BI).

- Develop attribution models (e.g.  media mix, multi-touch attribution) to clarify revenue contribution across platforms and improve investment efficiency.

- Partner with Marketing & Digital heads, Finance, Commercial and Revenue teams to forecast investment impacts and align marketing activities with commercial outcomes.

- Competitive analysis: monitor market conditions, competitive activity, and industry trends to support strategic planning and identify opportunities for differentiation and growth.

- Prepare executive-ready presentations, with clear data-based recommendations to support senior leadership strategic decision-making, leveraging stellar data visualization combined with depth of insights.

Your Journey so far

- 5+ years of prior experience in marketing analytics, commercial analytics, business intelligence, or performance marketing analysis.

- Preference for prior experience in the luxury hospitality/travel industry or consulting agencies.

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Commercial, or related field (Masters, MBA or equivalent experience preferred).

Your Essentials

- Proven experience supporting senior executives and thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment, managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.

- Highly Proficient in Excel and comfortable manipulating large datasets data and maintaining large spreadsheets with high level of accuracy

- Outstanding PowerPoint and storytelling skills — able to craft clean, crisp, high-impact presentations for C-suite audiences.

- Experience working with Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics or similar platforms, as well as BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.

- Knowledge of marketing measurement methodologies including attribution modelling, media mix modelling, customer segmentation, and ROI analysis.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Fluent in English.

- Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever-evolving travel industry.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.

Dove la passione incontra l'opportunità Scopri il tuo viaggio nello straordinario. Il tuo scopo Explora Journeys è un marchio di lusso europeo vibrante, cosmopolita, immaginato nel cuore dell'ospitalità svizzera a Ginevra. Sfruttando le centinaia di anni di esperienza marittima della nostra società madre MSC Group, la nostra flotta di sei navi di lusso (quattro attualmente in cantiere) sono state costruite e progettate in modo totalmente diverso e unico che trasformeranno e ridefiniranno l'esperienza di crociera, creando una categoria propria, attraendo la prossima generazione di viaggiatori di lusso. Esiste un'opportunità entusiasmante per un talentuoso, esperto di analisi, un professionista strategico e altamente organizzato con un forte acume di marketing, digitale e commerciale per unire il nostro marchio di viaggio di lusso di nuova creazione Explora Journeys, con sede nei nostri uffici a Ginevra, Svizzera. Il tuo impatto - L'obiettivo del ruolo è quello di ottimizzare gli investimenti di marketing full-funnel in modo olistico, massimizzare l'impatto dei ricavi e l'ottimizzazione ROI sui mercati. Questo ruolo è responsabile dell'analisi delle prestazioni attraverso il viaggio del cliente — dalla consapevolezza attraverso la lealtà — per identificare le opportunità di crescita, migliorare l'efficienza di marketing e guidare i risultati commerciali attraverso il processo decisionale basato sui dati. Analisi delle prestazioni: monitorare e analizzare le prestazioni di marketing contro i KPI di marca e commerciali, fornendo approfondimenti e raccomandazioni per un miglioramento continuo. Possedere lo sviluppo, il monitoraggio e l'azione dei KPI di marketing chiave attraverso touchpoint (tutti i canali pagati, di proprietà e guadagnati), le campagne e le prestazioni del pubblico. - Efficienza dell'azionamento, quantificazione ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA da campagna, touchpoint e pubblico per ogni mercato per ottimizzare continuamente gli investimenti. Raccomanda reinvestimenti verso attività di impatto più elevato, per colpire obiettivi di sensibilizzazione e ricavi. - Costruisci e mantieni le schede di punteggio di performance full-funnel per mercato (consapevolezza → considerazione → conversione → fedeltà) per identificare i colli di bottiglia di reddito e ottimizzare l'allocazione di bilancio tra i mercati. Sia in Excel che in collaborazione con il team aziendale per renderlo disponibile negli strumenti self-serve (Power BI). - Sviluppare modelli di attribuzione (ad esempio mix media, attribuzione multi-touch) per chiarire il contributo dei ricavi su piattaforme e migliorare l'efficienza degli investimenti. - Partner con i team Marketing & Digital Heads, Finance, Commercial e Revenue per prevedere impatti sugli investimenti e allineare le attività di marketing con risultati commerciali. - Analisi competitiva: monitorare le condizioni di mercato, l'attività competitiva e le tendenze del settore per sostenere la pianificazione strategica e identificare le opportunità di differenziazione e crescita. - Prepara presentazioni esecutive, con chiare raccomandazioni basate sui dati per supportare il processo decisionale strategico di leadership senior, sfruttando la visualizzazione dei dati stellari combinata con la profondità di insight. Il tuo viaggio finora - 5+ anni di esperienza precedente in analisi di marketing, analisi commerciali, business intelligence o analisi di marketing delle prestazioni. - Preferenza per esperienza precedente nel settore dell'ospitalità di lusso / viaggio o agenzie di consulenza. - Corso di laurea in Business, Economia, Finanza, Marketing, Commerciale o relativo campo (Master, MBA o equivalente esperienza preferita). I tuoi essenziali - Esperienza comprovata che supporta i dirigenti senior e prospera in un ambiente di avvio veloce, gestendo più priorità contemporaneamente. - Eccellente analitica e problem solving competenze con la capacità di tradurre i dati complessi in insight aziendali attuabili. - Eccezionale competenza in Excel e comoda manipolazione di dati di grandi dimensioni e mantenimento di grandi fogli di calcolo con alto livello di precisione - Straordinarie competenze di PowerPoint e storytelling — in grado di creare presentazioni pulite, croccanti, ad alto impatto per il pubblico C-suite. - Esperienza di lavoro con Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics o piattaforme simili, nonché strumenti di visualizzazione e BI come Tableau, Power BI, Looker o piattaforme simili. - Conoscenza delle metodologie di misura di marketing, tra cui la modellazione dell'attribuzione, la modellazione dei media, la segmentazione dei clienti e l'analisi ROI. - Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale. Fluente in inglese. - Passione e curiosità per conoscere continuamente l'industria del viaggio in continua evoluzione. A Explora Journeys, stiamo ridefinindo i viaggi oceanici di lusso - dove la scoperta, il benessere, e un profondo rispetto per i mari si uniscono in armonia.
• Cerchiamo professionisti appassionati che condividono la nostra visione di un modo più coinvolgente e trasformativo per scoprire le destinazioni più ispiranti del mondo dal mare. Sei pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a Explora Journeys, dove un oceano di opportunità attende. Il vostro viaggio verso lo Stato della Mente Oceano inizia qui.

Il tuo impatto - Definire ed eseguire la strategia di prodotto spa, compresi i trattamenti, i prodotti al dettaglio e i concetti di benessere, in linea con gli standard di marca e gli obiettivi aziendali - Gestire il ciclo di vita completo del prodotto, dallo sviluppo del concetto e dalla selezione dei fornitori al lancio, al monitoraggio delle prestazioni e all'ottimizzazione - Collaborare con gli stakeholder interni (Operazioni Spagna, Marketing, Formazione, Procurement, Finanza) per garantire l'implementazione dei prodotti senza soluzione di continuità - Lead rapporti dei fornitori e recensioni sulle prestazioni. - Analizzare le prestazioni del prodotto attraverso KPI, feedback degli ospiti e risultati finanziari, e implementare miglioramenti datadriven - Assicurarsi che tutti i prodotti siano conformi agli standard normativi, di sicurezza e di marca in tutte le sedi. - Sostenere lo sviluppo di strategie di prezzi, promozioni e iniziative orientate al reddito. - Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di formazione per garantire che i terapeuti e il personale siano pienamente formati su prodotti e trattamenti. - Monitorare le tendenze del mercato e le innovazioni all'interno del settore spa e benessere per mantenere un'offerta competitiva. - Sostenere nuove aperture, ristrutturazioni e progetti speciali legati allo sviluppo di prodotti spa. Il tuo viaggio finora - Forte mentalità commerciale e analitica con comprovata esperienza nella gestione delle prestazioni del prodotto - Eccellente capacità di gestione e comunicazione degli stakeholder - Capacità di gestire più progetti contemporaneamente in un ambiente di velocità - Pensiero strategico combinato con esecuzione hands-on - Forte capacità di negoziazione e gestione dei fornitori - Alta attenzione ai dettagli con un focus sulla qualità e l'esperienza degli ospiti - Esperienza dimostrata nella gestione del prodotto spa, benessere, bellezza o ospitalità - Forte comprensione delle operazioni di spa, dei trattamenti e degli ambienti al dettaglio - Esperienza di lavoro con marchi premium o di lusso preferisconore I tuoi essenziali - 10-15 anni di esperienza in SPA e Wellness tra cui trattamenti Medispa, prodotti di vendita al dettaglio e concetti di benessere, - Esperienza comprovata nella gestione del ciclo di vita completo del prodotto, dallo sviluppo del concetto e dalla selezione dei fornitori, requisiti legali, lancio, monitoraggio delle prestazioni e ottimizzazione. - Ottima capacità di comunicazione e leadership, soprattutto nel guidare grandi team e influenzare gli stakeholder. - La fluenza in inglese è obbligatoria qualsiasi altra lingua è un plus. - Forte capacità di leadership per supervisionare le operazioni SPA in più posizioni. - Esperienza con la gestione del progetto analisi finanziaria e gestione dei ricavi nel settore del benessere o dell'ospitalità. - Capacità di lavorare efficacemente con dipartimenti come Marketing Guest Services e Revenue Management per creare un'esperienza di benessere coesa per gli ospiti. - Nazionalità svizzera o diritto di lavoro in Svizzera. Il nostro impegno Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. descriptionByLocale.en: Your Purpose The SPA Product Manager is responsible for the strategic development, management, and optimization of spa products, treatments, and retail offerings. Our commitment We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.title: Brand Manager - Brand & Product
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

Part of the global Marketing team and reporting directly to the Brand Director, this role plays a central role in safeguarding, shaping and activating the Explora Journeys brand across all touchpoints, with a particular focus on brand campaigns, the fleet and new brand developments.

Based at our headquarters in Geneva, this role sits at the intersection of brand strategy, product storytelling, and execution, working closely with Product, Design, Hotel Operations, Commercial, PR, Media, and Digital teams to bring the brand to life with clarity, consistency and emotional depth, across markets.

Your Impact

Brand Management & Governance

- Act as a core guardian of the Explora Journeys brand, supporting the Brand Director in the day to day management, development, and evolution of the brand.

- Ensure consistent application of brand identity, tone of voice, messaging, and visual language across all touchpoints, channels, and guest journeys.

- Lead the development, evolution and maintenance of brand guidelines, frameworks, and master toolkits, ensuring relevance, clarity, and scalability globally.

- Monitor brand execution across markets and partners, proactively identifying inconsistencies and working collaboratively with stakeholders to safeguard luxury and hospitality standards.

- Contribute to brand strategy initiatives, brand evolution projects, and internal brand education, strengthening brand understanding and alignment across the organisation.

Campaigns, Content & Brand Activation

- Lead the development and delivery of master brand and product campaigns, in line with brand strategy and commercial priorities.

- Oversee the creation of hero brand and product assets, including key visuals, copy frameworks, brochures, photography, and videography.

- Work closely with Media, Digital, and PR teams to ensure a coherent  and premium brand expression across paid, owned, and earned channels.

- Manage and curate brand, product and fleet content within DAM and PIM systems, ensuring accuracy, ease of use and global market adoption.

Product Marketing – Fleet & Onboard Experience

- Own and articulate the brand and product narrative for the Explora Journeys fleet, translating ship design, onboard experiences and service philosophy into compelling, clear, and guest-centric storytelling.

- Act as a key brand partner to Product, New Builds and Hotel Operations teams, supporting projects throughout the ship lifecycle; from early concept through delivery, launch and in-service evolution.

- Define and activate ship level propositions and concepts, onboard experiences, suite concepts, culinary, wellness and retail pillars, and service rituals.

- Ensure alignment between the onboard guest experience and the brand promise communicated to market.

Launch & Go to Market Coordination

- Support brand and product readiness for new brand initiatives, campaigns, ship launches, major milestones, and onboard innovations.

- Develop master launch toolkits to equip channels, markets, Sales, and PR with clear narratives, positioning and assets.

- Ensure consistency, clarity and brand alignment across all internal and external communications related to brand, fleet and product evolution.

Cross Functional Collaboration & Operational Excellence

- Act as a trusted brand partner across functions, fostering alignment between brand, product, commercial, and operational teams

- Coordinate budgets, suppliers, forecasting, purchase orders, and invoicing related to brand initiatives.

- Balance strategic brand thinking with hands on execution in a fast paced environment.

Your Journey so far

- Master’s degree in Marketing, Brand Management, Product Marketing, or a related field.

- 8+ years’ experience in brand management and campaign building.

- Prior experience within luxury, premium or high-end travel, hospitality or consumer brands strongly preferred.

- Proven experience operating in a global headquarters environment, managing brand frameworks and master assets across markets.

- Experience managing agencies and external creative partners.

Your Essentials

- Exposure to product marketing and physical experience‑based products (ships, hotels, resorts, or complex premium environments highly desirable).

- Strong creative sensibility combined with operational rigour, attention to detail and stakeholder management skills.

- Comfortable moving between strategic brand thinking and detailed execution.

- Fluent in English; additional European languages are a strong advantage.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

jobs.title: Mobile App Product Specialist
jobs.description:
Your Purpose

We are seeking a dynamic and highly motivated Mobile App Product Specialist to join our Business Innovation team at MSC Cruises Headquarters in Geneva. This role is designed for a data-driven professional with a strong commercial acumen, an analytical mindset, and a passion for optimizing mobile user journeys. The successful candidate will explore in-app behaviors, remove friction in the sales funnel, and drive product-led initiatives to maximize conversion rates and shape the future of digital guest experiences across the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

Your Impact

- Analyze the MSC for Me in-app user journey and behavior to identify bottlenecks, proposing and validating product initiatives that optimize the sales funnel and boost in-app conversion rates.

- Collaborate with Product, Tech, and UX/UI cross-functional teams to design and implement features that drive organic user acquisition and increase cross-selling/up-selling opportunities for the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Implement and optimize the in-app position of commercial offerings (working closing with Onboard Revenues Commercial Department) to maximize visibility and sales conversions specifically for mobile users.

- Use advanced product analytics tools and data visualization (Power BI) to track sales performance, user activation rates, and drop-offs into the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Act as a bridge between the Onboard Revenues Commercial department and the Tech/Development teams, translating revenue goals into clear digital product requirements to enhance the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Drive MSC for Me  channel-led acquisition by refining native in-app features—such as frictionless guest-to-registered user flows, invite-a-friend mechanisms, and seamless app sharing—to grow the user base.

- Conduct A/B testing on MSC for Me  in-app sales flows, checkout processes, and subscription models to continuously improve operational efficiency and revenue generation.

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Marketing Management, Digital or a related field.

- Strong commercial and analytical skills with 3 to 5 years of proven experience in digital sales, product growth, or digital business development, with a strict focus on mobile applications.

- Hands-on experience with app analytics, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), and data manipulation/visualization tools (Power BI, SQL; Python is a plus).

- Familiarity with agile methodologies and ability to work side-by-side with developers and product managers in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate data-driven insights into actionable business and product recommendations.

- Creative thinker with a proactive approach to problem-solving, capable of driving "Product-Led Growth" rather than relying on traditional marketing spend.

- Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.

Your Essentials

- Deep understanding of mobile user behavior, digital sales funnels, and product-centric acquisition ecosystems.

- Strong business acumen with a focus on maximizing Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) and removing friction from the mobile buying experience.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outputs under tight deadlines.

VISA REQUIREMENTS (if any) :

- Right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

titleByLocale.it: Casino Slots and Technical Operations Manager
titleByLocale.de: Casino Slots and Technical Operations Manager
titleByLocale.fr: Casino Slots and Technical Operations Manager

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

Lead Onboard Casino Technical teams, ensuring smooth operations, maintaining high standards of service, and maximising revenue generation. As a Casino Slot and Technical Operations Manager, you will be responsible for monitoring slot machine performance, analysing gaming data, and implementing strategies to enhance player satisfaction and profitability. Your role will involve regular inspections and maintenance scheduling to ensure all slot machines are functioning correctly and efficiently. You will also be responsible for managing inventory, ordering new equipment, and coordinating installations and upgrades. You will be expected to stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies, proactively adapting operations to maintain compliance and competitive advantage.

Your Impact

• Oversee all technical projects and actively participate in their implementation. Maintain an excellent line of communication with the shore and ship technical department to ensure all casino projects are deployed according to schedule and comply to the company’s technical and safety standards.
• Assist with budgeting, forecasting and revenue analysis.
• Manage budgets, control costs, and optimise resource allocation.
• Support and guide onboard Casino management team on each vessel through constant communication and regular ship operational visits. Discuss any areas of concern specific to the Operation and brand specific product, and similarly address points of commendation.
• Provide accurate and objective assessment of onboard Casino operations and personnel.
• Revenue analysis, identifying trends with the ability to create structured solutions to increase or enhance revenue streams. Explore new ways of increasing existing revenue and /or improving current working practices, whilst at the same time maintaining a high technical and security standard onboard our ships.
• Isolate areas falling below standard with members of the Casino Shipboard management team.
• Training of all management teams in Slot Revenue, Security and Surveillance.
• Confirm that security measures meet minimum requirements.
• Provide troubleshooting support and advice via email to shipboard technical teams.
• Assess, evaluate and review data for organizing projects and/or providing directions on activities, tasks or processes in accordance with company guidelines.

Your Journey so far

• Minimum 5 years of experience in casino slot operations management.
• Previous experience working on a cruise ship is mandatory.

Your Essentials

• Strong knowledge of gaming regulations and compliance requirements.
• Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
• Proficiency in analysing gaming data and financial reports.
• Ability to manage budgets, control costs, and optimize resources.

jobs.title: Digital Acquisition Manager
jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Senior Digital Acquisition Manager will be responsible for leading the digital marketing strategy across all MSC Cruises markets, with a focus on driving direct sales through digital advertising levers, setting and achieving KPIs, and developing innovative digital campaigns across multiple channels. The successful candidate will have a proven track record in performance marketing and digital sales development at a positive ROAS, along with strong expertise in digital advertising campaign strategy, paid media planning and implementation, and team leadership. Additionally, the role will involve developing affiliation and partnership programs as part of an integrated digital engagement strategy to broaden reach, drive qualified traffic, and support long-term customer value.

Your Impact

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with MSC stakeholders across various markets, with a deep understanding of their business needs, challenges, and opportunities—while balancing the global objectives set by headquarters.

• Set and achieve KPIs for online sales through digital advertising levers, ensuring the media agency delivers against targets and contractual obligations.

• Lead internal meetings, QBRs, and annual reviews by providing strategic insights and recommendations based on campaign performance, website analytics, market trends, and the competitive landscape.

• Plan and implement innovative performance marketing campaigns across Paid Search, Display, Social, Native, Digital Audio, and Video channels—tailored to business goals and market dynamics.

• Collaborate with internal teams—including Creative, Social Media, Data & Analytics, SEO, Content, Product, and agency partners—to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality assets aligned with annual digital sales targets.

• Identify and pursue opportunities to enhance revenue streams through existing and new digital strategies, while improving campaign ROAS and experimenting with innovations in the adtech and martech ecosystem.

• Develop and manage lead generation strategies, ensuring effective customer acquisition flows and nurturing tactics are in place across all paid media touchpoints.

• Maintain oversight of account resourcing and profitability to ensure HQ and local markets are managed efficiently and profitably.

• Serve as the main escalation point for concerns raised by internal teams or local market stakeholders.

• Continuously review and optimize operational workflows, proposing and implementing process improvements where relevant.

• Collaborate with country and HQ stakeholders to prepare and manage the annual digital marketing budget, aligned with MSC Cruises’ B2C revenue goals.

• Lead and optimize affiliate and partnership programs to drive qualified traffic and conversions, ensuring alignment with digital acquisition strategy and performance goals.

• Manage key partners and co-branded initiatives, coordinating with internal teams to ensure seamless execution and tracking.

Your Journey so far

• 7+ years of experience in a similar role.
• Hands-on experience with analytics and ad server tools such as GA4, Adobe Analytics, Campaign Manager and their relevant reporting frameworks.
• Proven experience in managing, mentoring, and upskilling team members.
• Past experience in lead generation strategy and execution is a strong plus.
• Solid experience in budget ownership and cost control.

Your Essentials

• Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus).
• Strong analytical skills and the ability to leverage data for informed decision-making.
• Proven track record of driving direct sales growth and improving ROAS through high-performing digital advertising campaigns.
• Passion for digital marketing, performance media, and innovative digital solutions.
• Deep knowledge of Google and Meta ad platforms, including setup auditing, implementation, and performance analysis with actionable insights.
• Excellent organizational, project management, and problem-solving skills.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office and data visualization tools such as Datorama.
• Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams and external partners.
• Ability to identify trends in data and transform insights into actionable strategic recommendations.
• Self-starter with the ability to work independently and take initiative.
• Confident, articulate presenter—comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders and internal teams.
• Strong strategic thinking, capable of acting as a ‘Trusted Advisor’ to senior leadership.
• High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
• Positive attitude, proactive mindset, and a drive to embrace new challenges.
• Knowledge of affiliate platforms such as Awin, Kwanko, and similar tools. Strong network of industry contacts to initiate partnership opportunities and brand collaborations.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Head of Learning & Development (Onboard & Ashore) and Talent Management (Ashore) is responsible for defining and leading the global strategy for Learning and Development across both shipboard and shore-based employees, while overseeing Talent Management and Succession Planning for shore-based populations only.
The role ensures the company develops the capabilities required to deliver exceptional guest experiences, operational excellence, and strong leadership across a global workforce, including thousands of shipboard crew and a diverse shore-based organization.
For shipboard employees, the role focuses on building world-class operational and service capabilities through structured training, leadership development, and career progression frameworks that support fleet performance and guest satisfaction.
For shore-based employees, the role leads both Learning & Development and Talent Management, including leadership development, succession planning, and talent pipeline development for corporate and operational leadership roles.
Working closely with senior operational leaders across Operations, Guest Experience, and Corporate Functions, this role drives a culture of continuous learning, leadership excellence, and organizational capability building across the company’s global operations.

Your Impact

Global Learning & Development Strategy (Onboard & Ashore)

- Define and implement the global Learning & Development strategy covering both shipboard crew and shore-based employees.

- Develop an integrated learning ecosystem that supports operational excellence onboard and leadership capability ashore.

- Ensure learning initiatives directly support strategic priorities such as:

- guest experience excellence

- safety and compliance

- operational performance

- leadership effectiveness

- digital and business transformation

- Oversee onboarding and development frameworks to accelerate employee integration and performance across both shipboard and shore environments.

- Lead the adoption of modern learning approaches including digital learning, simulation-based training, microlearning, and blended learning solutions.

Shipboard Learning & Development

- Lead the design and delivery of the global shipboard learning and development strategy across the fleet.

- Partner closely with Marine Operations, Hotel Operations, Food & Beverage, and Guest Experience leadership to ensure training programs support operational priorities and service excellence.

- Ensure consistent training standards across the fleet while accommodating the operational realities of shipboard environments.

- Oversee development programs for key shipboard roles, including supervisory and management development programs for future onboard leaders.

- Support structured career development pathways for shipboard crew, enabling internal progression across hospitality and operational functions.

- Ensure alignment with all maritime regulatory training requirements and safety standards.

Shore-Based Learning & Development

- Lead the design and implementation of learning and development programs for shore-based employees across corporate and operational functions.

- Develop capability-building initiatives supporting key business priorities such as:

- commercial capabilities

- digital transformation

- operational excellence

- guest-centric culture

- Design structured leadership development programs for emerging, mid-level, and senior leaders.

- Develop functional academies and capability frameworks supporting critical corporate disciplines.

Talent Management & Succession Planning (Ashore Only)

- Define and implement the company’s global talent management strategy for shore-based employees.

- Lead processes for:

- talent identification and talent reviews

- succession planning for critical leadership roles

- high-potential development programs

- leadership pipeline development

- career development frameworks

- Partner with executive leadership and HR Business Partners to ensure strong succession pipelines for key corporate and operational leadership positions ashore.

- Embed talent management practices into performance management and leadership development frameworks.

Leadership Development

- Design and implement leadership development programs supporting both shipboard and shore-based leadership populations.

- Establish a global leadership framework aligned with the company’s values and guest-centric culture.

- Strengthen leadership capabilities in areas such as:

- people leadership

- operational decision-making

- service excellence

- innovation and continuous improvement

- cross-cultural leadership

Your Journey so far

Education

- Master’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or related field.

Experience

- 15+ years of progressive experience in Learning & Development, Talent Management, or Organizational Development.

- Significant experience designing and implementing global learning strategies for large, international workforces.

- Proven experience leading talent management and succession planning programs for corporate leadership populations.

- Experience in cruise, hospitality, travel, aviation, or other large service-driven organizations strongly preferred.

- Experience working in highly multicultural and geographically distributed environments.

Key Competences

- Strategic Learning & Capability Development

- Talent Management & Succession Planning (Corporate)

- Service Excellence & Hospitality Culture

- Stakeholder Influence & Executive Partnership

- Global Mindset & Cultural Intelligence

- Organizational Development

- Learning Technology & Digital Learning

Your Essentials

- Fluency in English is required; Italian, French, German or other European languages are a plus.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.de: Dein Zweck Der Head of Learning & Development (Onboard & Ashore) und Talent Management (Ashore) ist dafür verantwortlich, die globale Strategie für Lernen und Entwicklung sowohl für Mitarbeiter an Bord als auch an Land zu definieren und zu leiten, während er Talent Management und Nachfolgeplanung nur für an Land ansässige Bevölkerungen überwacht. Die Rolle stellt sicher, dass das Unternehmen die Fähigkeiten entwickelt, die erforderlich sind, um außergewöhnliche Gästeerlebnisse, operative Exzellenz und eine starke Führungsrolle in einer globalen Belegschaft zu bieten, darunter Tausende von Schiffsbesatzungen und eine vielfältige Organisation an Land. Für Mitarbeiter an Bord konzentriert sich die Rolle auf den Aufbau von erstklassigen Betriebs- und Servicefähigkeiten durch strukturierte Schulungen, Führungsentwicklung und Karriereentwicklungsrahmen, die die Leistung der Flotte und die Gästezufriedenheit unterstützen. Für Mitarbeiter an Land führt die Rolle sowohl Learning & Development als auch Talent Management, einschließlich Führungskräfteentwicklung, Nachfolgeplanung und Talentpipeline-Entwicklung für Unternehmens- und operative Führungsrollen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden operativen Führungskräften in den Bereichen Operations, Guest Experience und Corporate Functions treibt diese Rolle eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens, der Führungsqualität und des Aufbaus organisatorischer Fähigkeiten in den globalen Aktivitäten des Unternehmens voran. Ihre Wirkung Globale Lern- und Entwicklungsstrategie (Onboard & Ashore) - Definieren und implementieren Sie die globale Lern- und Entwicklungsstrategie, die sowohl die Schiffsbesatzung als auch die Mitarbeiter an Land abdeckt. - Entwicklung eines integrierten Lernökosystems, das operative Exzellenz an Bord und Führungskompetenz an Land unterstützt. - Sicherstellen, dass Lerninitiativen strategische Prioritäten direkt unterstützen, wie: - Gasterlebnis Exzellenz - Sicherheit und Einhaltung - Betriebsleistung - Führungswirksamkeit - Digitale und Business Transformation - Beaufsichtigen Sie Onboarding- und Entwicklungs-Frameworks, um die Integration und Leistung der Mitarbeiter sowohl an Bord als auch an Land zu beschleunigen. - Führen Sie die Einführung moderner Lernansätze wie digitales Lernen, simulationsbasiertes Training, Microlearning und Blended-Learning-Lösungen an. Shipboard Learning & Development - Führen Sie die Gestaltung und Umsetzung der globalen Lern- und Entwicklungsstrategie an Bord der gesamten Flotte. - Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Führung von Marine Operations, Hotel Operations, Food & Beverage und Guest Experience, um sicherzustellen, dass Schulungsprogramme die operativen Prioritäten und Service-Exzellenz unterstützen. - Gewährleistung einheitlicher Ausbildungsstandards für die gesamte Flotte und gleichzeitige Berücksichtigung der betrieblichen Gegebenheiten an Bord. - Beaufsichtigen Sie Entwicklungsprogramme für wichtige Bordrollen, einschließlich Aufsichts- und Managemententwicklungsprogramme für zukünftige Bordleiter. - Unterstützung strukturierter Karriereentwicklungspfade für die Schiffsbesatzung, die eine interne Weiterentwicklung in den Bereichen Hospitality und Betriebsfunktionen ermöglichen. - Gewährleistung der Angleichung an alle Ausbildungsanforderungen und Sicherheitsstandards für die maritime Regulierung. Landgestütztes Lernen & Entwicklung - Führen Sie die Gestaltung und Umsetzung von Lern- und Entwicklungsprogrammen für Mitarbeiter an Land in allen Unternehmens- und Betriebsfunktionen. - Entwicklung von Initiativen zum Aufbau von Fähigkeiten zur Unterstützung wichtiger Geschäftsprioritäten wie: - kommerzielle Kapazitäten - Digitale Transformation - Operative Exzellenz - Gastzentrierte Kultur - Entwerfen Sie strukturierte Führungsentwicklungsprogramme für aufstrebende, mittlere und leitende Führungskräfte. - Entwicklung funktionaler Akademien und Fähigkeitsrahmen, die kritische Unternehmensdisziplinen unterstützen. Talent Management & Nachfolgeplanung (nur an Land) - Definieren und implementieren Sie die globale Talentmanagement-Strategie des Unternehmens für Mitarbeiter an Land. - Leitprozesse für: - Talentidentifizierung und Talent Reviews - Nachfolgeplanung für kritische Führungsrollen - Entwicklungsprogramme mit hohem Potenzial - Leadership Pipeline Entwicklung - Laufbahnentwicklungsrahmen - Partnerschaft mit Führungskräften und HR Business Partners, um starke Nachfolge-Pipelines für wichtige Unternehmens- und operative Führungspositionen an Land sicherzustellen. - Einbetten von Talent-Management-Praktiken in Performance-Management und Führungskräfteentwicklung Frameworks. Führungskräfteentwicklung - Entwerfen und implementieren Sie Führungsentwicklungsprogramme, die sowohl die Führungsbevölkerung an Bord als auch an Land unterstützen. - Etablieren Sie einen globalen Führungsrahmen, der sich an den Werten und der gastorientierten Kultur des Unternehmens orientiert. - Stärkung der Führungskompetenzen in Bereichen wie: - Menschenführung - operative Entscheidungsfindung - Service Excellence - Innovation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung - Interkulturelle Führung Deine Reise bisher Bildung - Master-Abschluss in Human Resources, Organisationsentwicklung, Business Administration oder verwandten Bereich. Erfahrung - 15+ Jahre fortschrittliche Erfahrung in Learning & Development, Talent Management oder Organisationsentwicklung. - Bedeutende Erfahrung in der Gestaltung und Umsetzung globaler Lernstrategien für große, internationale Arbeitskräfte. - Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit führenden Talentmanagement- und Nachfolgeplanungsprogrammen für Unternehmensführungsgruppen. - Erfahrung in Kreuzfahrt, Gastfreundschaft, Reise, Luftfahrt oder anderen großen Service-getriebenen Organisationen stark bevorzugt. - Erfahrung in hochgradig multikulturellen und geografisch verteilten Umgebungen. Schlüsselkompetenzen - Strategisches Lernen & Capability Development - Talent Management & Nachfolgeplanung (Unternehmen) - Service Excellence & Hospitality Kultur - Stakeholder-Einfluss & Executive Partnership - Global Mindset & Cultural Intelligence - Organisationsentwicklung - Lerntechnologie & Digitales Lernen Ihre Essentials - Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich; Italienisch, Französisch, Deutsch oder andere europäische Sprachen sind ein Plus. Unser Engagement Wir setzen uns für eine Zukunft ein, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven wertschätzt, die Welt über Grenzen hinaus umfasst und ein integratives Umfeld fördert, in dem sich jeder Mensch geschätzt, respektiert und ermächtigt fühlt, sein authentisches Selbst zu sein. Unser Engagement erstreckt sich auf sinnvolle, messbare Maßnahmen, die sich langfristig positiv auf unsere Gäste, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten auswirken. Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Begleiten Sie uns auf MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten auf Sie warten. Bewerben Sie sich noch heute, um Teil eines globalen Teams zu sein, das Grenzen überschreitet und etwas Bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!
descriptionByLocale.fr: Votre but Le responsable de l'apprentissage et du perfectionnement (à bord et à terre) et de la gestion des talents (à terre) est chargé de définir et de diriger la stratégie globale d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement à la fois pour les employés à bord et à terre, tout en surveillant la gestion des talents et la planification de la relève pour les populations à terre seulement. Ce rôle permet à l'entreprise de développer les capacités nécessaires pour offrir des expériences exceptionnelles aux clients, l'excellence opérationnelle et un leadership solide à l'échelle mondiale, y compris des milliers d'équipages de navires et une organisation à terre diversifiée. Pour les employés de bord, le rôle consiste à renforcer les capacités opérationnelles et de service de calibre mondial au moyen d'une formation structurée, d'un perfectionnement en leadership et de cadres de progression de carrière qui appuient le rendement de la flotte et la satisfaction des clients. Pour les employés à terre, le rôle est à la fois responsable de l'apprentissage et du perfectionnement et de la gestion des talents, y compris le perfectionnement du leadership, la planification de la relève et le perfectionnement des talents pour les rôles de leadership organisationnel et opérationnel. Travaillant en étroite collaboration avec des dirigeants opérationnels supérieurs dans l'ensemble des opérations, de l'expérience des invités et des fonctions ministérielles, ce rôle est à l'origine d'une culture d'apprentissage continu, d'excellence en leadership et de renforcement des capacités organisationnelles dans l'ensemble des opérations mondiales de l'entreprise. Votre impact Stratégie mondiale d'apprentissage et de développement (à bord et à terre) - Définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie globale d'apprentissage et de développement qui couvre à la fois les équipages et les employés à terre. - Développer un écosystème d'apprentissage intégré qui appuie l'excellence opérationnelle à bord et la capacité de leadership à terre. - Veiller à ce que les initiatives d'apprentissage appuient directement les priorités stratégiques telles que : - excellence de l'expérience des invités - sécurité et conformité - performance opérationnelle - efficacité de la direction - transformation numérique et des entreprises - Superviser les cadres d'intégration et de perfectionnement pour accélérer l'intégration et le rendement des employés à bord des navires et à terre. - Diriger l'adoption d'approches d'apprentissage modernes, y compris l'apprentissage numérique, la formation fondée sur la simulation, le microapprentissage et les solutions d'apprentissage mixte. Apprentissage et développement à bord des navires - Diriger la conception et la prestation de la stratégie globale d'apprentissage et de développement à bord des navires dans l'ensemble de la flotte. - S'associer étroitement aux opérations maritimes, aux opérations hôtelières, aux aliments et boissons et à la direction de l'Expérience invitée pour s'assurer que les programmes de formation appuient les priorités opérationnelles et l'excellence des services. - Assurer l'uniformité des normes de formation dans l'ensemble de la flotte tout en tenant compte des réalités opérationnelles des environnements de bord. - Superviser les programmes de perfectionnement pour les rôles clés à bord des navires, y compris les programmes de supervision et de perfectionnement de la gestion pour les futurs dirigeants à bord. - Appuyer les parcours structurés de perfectionnement professionnel pour les équipages de bord, ce qui permet une progression interne dans l'ensemble des fonctions d'accueil et d'exploitation. - Assurer l'alignement sur toutes les exigences en matière de formation réglementaire maritime et les normes de sécurité. Apprentissage et développement à terre - Diriger la conception et la mise en oeuvre de programmes d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement pour les employés à terre dans l'ensemble des fonctions ministérielles et opérationnelles. - Élaborer des initiatives de renforcement des capacités à l'appui des principales priorités opérationnelles, notamment : - capacités commerciales - transformation numérique - excellence opérationnelle - Culture centrée sur les invités - Concevoir des programmes structurés de perfectionnement en leadership à l'intention des dirigeants émergents, moyens et supérieurs. - Élaborer des académies fonctionnelles et des cadres de capacités qui appuient les disciplines organisationnelles essentielles. Gestion des talents et planification de la relève (à terre seulement) - Définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie globale de gestion des talents pour les employés à terre. - Processus principaux pour: - identification des talents et examens des talents - planification de la relève pour les rôles critiques de leadership - programmes de développement à fort potentiel - développement de pipelines de leadership - Cadres d ' organisation des carrières - Établir des partenariats avec les cadres supérieurs et les partenaires d'affaires des RH afin d'assurer une relève solide pour les postes clés de leadership organisationnel et opérationnel à terre. - Intégrer les pratiques de gestion des talents dans les cadres de gestion du rendement et de perfectionnement du leadership. Développement du leadership - Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des programmes de perfectionnement en leadership à l'appui des populations de dirigeants à bord des navires et à terre. - Mettre en place un cadre mondial de leadership aligné sur les valeurs de l'entreprise et la culture centrée sur les invités. - Renforcer les capacités de leadership dans des domaines tels que : - leadership des personnes - prise de décisions opérationnelles - excellence des services - innovation et amélioration continue - Le leadership interculturel Votre voyage jusqu'à présent Éducation - Maîtrise en ressources humaines, développement organisationnel, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe. Expérience - 15 ans et plus d'expérience progressive en apprentissage et développement, gestion des talents ou développement organisationnel. - Expérience importante de la conception et de la mise en oeuvre de stratégies d'apprentissage à l'échelle mondiale pour les grands travailleurs internationaux. - Expérience éprouvée des principaux programmes de gestion des talents et de planification de la relève pour les populations de leadership ministériel. - L'expérience des croisières, de l'accueil, des voyages, de l'aviation ou d'autres grandes organisations axées sur le service a fortement préféré. - Expérience de travail dans des environnements très multiculturels et géographiquement répartis. Compétences clés - Apprentissage stratégique et développement des capacités - Gestion des talents et planification de la relève (société) - Excellence du service et culture d'accueil - Influence des intervenants et partenariat exécutif - Global Mindset & Intelligence culturelle - Développement organisationnel - Apprentissage Technologie & Apprentissage numérique Vos essentiels - La maîtrise de l'anglais est requise; l'italien, le français, l'allemand ou d'autres langues européennes sont un plus. Notre engagement Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir qui valorise les diverses perspectives, embrasse le monde au-delà des frontières et favorise un environnement inclusif où chaque individu se sent valorisé, respecté et habilité à être lui-même authentique. Notre engagement s'étend à prendre des mesures significatives et mesurables qui ont un impact positif à long terme sur nos invités, nos employés et notre planète. Prêt à transformer votre passion en quelque chose d'extraordinaire ? Rejoignez-nous à MSC Cruises, où de nouvelles opportunités vous attendent. Faites une demande aujourd'hui pour faire partie d'une équipe mondiale qui repousse les frontières et réalise quelque chose de remarquable. Votre voyage commence ici !
